# Urgent Repair Request for Leaking Bathroom Ceiling and Heat Issues

A polite but firm email works best here: state the problems, the start date, the worsening condition, and request prompt action. Keep it factual, concise, and easy to act on.

# Tenant Email Draft

**Subject:** Urgent Repair Request: Leaking Bathroom Ceiling and Intermittent Heat in 2-Bedroom Apartment

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I am writing to request urgent repairs for two issues in my 2-bedroom apartment in Vancouver:

- A leaking bathroom ceiling
- Intermittent heat throughout the unit

The issue started on **2026-02-14** and has worsened over the past **10 days**. The leaking ceiling is becoming more concerning, and the heating problem is affecting comfort and livability in the apartment.

Please arrange for these repairs as soon as possible and let me know when a contractor or maintenance person can attend. I would appreciate a prompt response, as both issues need to be addressed without further delay.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Full Name]
[Apartment Number / Address]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

# What to Document Before Sending

- Photos or short videos of the bathroom ceiling leak and any visible water damage
- Dates and times when the heat stopped working or became inconsistent
- Any temperature readings inside the apartment, if available
- Notes on whether the leak is active, getting larger, or causing stains, dripping, or mold
- Copies of any previous messages or repair requests about these issues
- The exact apartment address and unit number
- A record of how the problems affect daily living, especially in colder weather

# Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Copy Email Draft] https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/air-quality/indoor-air-contaminants.html
- Action: [Button: Tenant Rights BC] https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/housing-tenancy/residential-tenancies
- Action: [Button: Repair Log Template] https://www.consumerprotectionbc.ca/consumer-help/rentals-housing/

# Sources

- BC Residential Tenancy Branch: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/housing-tenancy/residential-tenancies
- Health Canada indoor air quality guidance: https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/air-quality/indoor-air-contaminants.html
- Consumer Protection BC rentals help: https://www.consumerprotectionbc.ca/consumer-help/rentals-housing/
